zh-TW: 不動產廠房及設備週轉率

definition.zh-TW: 不動產、廠房及設備的淨額能帶出多少營業收入。次數越高表示設備用得越有效率；重資產產業的數值通常偏低，宜和同業比較。
definition.en: How much revenue the property, plant and equipment generates relative to its carrying amount. Higher means the equipment is used more efficiently; asset-heavy industries tend to show low values, so compare within the industry.

ifrsNote.zh-TW: IFRS 不定義財務比率；這個名稱是國際通用說法，計算口徑以指標登錄檔的版本為準。
ifrsNote.en: IFRS does not define financial ratios. The name follows international usage; the calculation basis is the version in the ratio registry.
